text.p: Italian bonds and BTP futures held firmer in late afternoon trading near the day's highs awaiting preliminary June inflation data from five Italian cities while still taking support from EMU optimism, dealers said.
Economists forecast a June CPI annual rate of 1.5/1.6 percent after May's 1.6 percent with five cites reporting today and a further six cities reporting on Monday.

They added that the BTP market had resumed gains after the profit taking seen on Thursday took the market off fresh record highs, and market sentiment was positive with further gains seen likely next week.
